How accurate is this?
  • Measured: wall dimensions from the county assessor's sketch; roof pitches (8/12 main, 4.5/12 rear dormer), ridge and eave heights, terrain and tree positions from the 2017 state LiDAR survey.
  • From photos: materials, colours, porch, deck, chimney, rear windows and doors (2017 listing); drive, pool and beds (2024 orthophoto).
  • Estimated: front and side window positions, plantings, boulders, anything changed since 2017.
